senses.gloss:
m. (-यः)
1 Heap, assemblage, collection.
2 Certainty.
E.
नि before चिञ् to collect, affix अच्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Having or containing a quantity. full of, redolent with, abounding.
E.
निचय, and इनि aff.

f. (-की)
A capital cow: see नैचिकी.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Full, filled.
2 Covered, overspread.
E.
नि before चि to collect, affix क्त.

m. (-लः)
1 A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.)
2 An upper and outer garment.
E.
नि before चुल to lift up, affix क.

n. (-कं)
A breast-plate, a cuirass.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; also निचोलक.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
A cover, a wrapper, a veil, a surtout.
E.
नि before चुल to lift up, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of jacket, but especially a soldier's jacket or a body dress, serving as a cuirass or breast-plate.
E.
कन added to निचोल.

f. (-विः)
A district, the modern Tirhut.
E.
नि constantly, छवि light.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Unimpeached.
E.
नि neg. च्छिद्र flaw.

m. (-विः)
A man of one of the degraded classes, born from the outcast Kṣatriya; the occupation of this caste is apparently public exhibition of tricks, prize-fighting, &c. being classed with the Jhallas, Mallas, and others.
E.
नि privative, छवि light or credit, इ substituted for the penultimate.

m. (-दः)
1 Cutting off.
2 (In Arithmetic,) Leaving no common measure.
E.
नि, and छेद cutting.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
1 Low, (in stature,) short, dwarfish.
2 Low, (in condition,) vile, base, mean.
3 Deep.
E.
न privative, ई good fortune, चि to obtain, aff. ड.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Low, dwarfish, a dwarf.
2 Vile, low.
f. (-का)
An excellent cow.
E.
कन added to the preceding.

m. (-की)
1 The head or top of any thing.
2 The owner of a good cow.

ind.
Low, below, little, vile, &c.
E.
नीचैस् low, अकच् inserted.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Low, vile, base.
n. (-गं)
Water.
f. (-गा)
A river.
E.
नीच low or deep, and ग who is going.

m. (-ज्यः)
An onion.
E.
नीच a low man, and भोज्य food.

f. (-का)
A good cow; also नीचिकी and नैचिकी.

ind.
Little, small, low.
E.
नि before चि to collect, डैसि aff. and the vowel of नि made long.
